summary: Enbridge Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a US$2.1 billion three-tranche senior notes offering: US$700 million 5.450% notes due 2032, US$800 million 5.850% notes due 2036 and US$600 million 6.350% notes due 2056, priced at 99.922%, 99.716% and 99.588% respectively, with semi-annual coupons beginning 2027. The notes are unsecured, unsubordinated and fully guaranteed by Enbridge Energy Partners, L.P. and Spectra Energy Partners, LP, both indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries. This is a routine debt capital-markets takedown under an existing shelf, not a special situation; no equity, change-of-control or deal terms are involved. Watch credit spreads and leverage rather than arbitrage.
